decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the submitted drawings, a scheme for replacement fireplaces fireplaces to the front and rear sitting rooms (ground floor) shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the relevant part of the development is commenced. Development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - New joinery shall be in accordance with Technical Note No. 3 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects. New brickwork shall be in accordance with Technical Note 1.

Condition : 6 - Before the relevant part of the work is commenced a detailed scheme shall be submitted showing the areas of paving and planting, including detailed specifications of planting and hard landscaping. The scheme shall be completed in accordance with the approved details.
description: Erection of gated wall to side elevation, alterations to conservatory at rear, internal layout alterations and paving of garden at front of house.
